The throwing guard is `assertCan()` in `src/lib/permissions.ts`. When a check fails, it throws a `PermissionDeniedError` instead of returning `false`.

Fourteen service files under `src/server/services/` call it. I found no renamed imports and no calls like `permissions.assertCan`.

Some files mention `assertCan` but don't call it, so I left them out:
- **Comments only:** `src/actions/_lib/action-errors.ts`, `src/components/domain/member/invite-member-form.tsx` and `src/components/domain/permission/permission-gate.tsx`.
- **Tests:** `tests/contract/permissions.test.ts` and `tests/lib/permissions.ownership.test.ts` call it, but they're tests rather than source files. `tests/repositories/issue-repository.test.ts` only spies on it.
- **Scripts:** `scripts/build-manifest.ts` and `scripts/manifest-parts/server.ts` only name it in text and lists.

ANSWER: src/server/services/label-service.ts, src/server/services/member-service.ts, src/server/services/issue-service.ts, src/server/services/activity-service.ts, src/server/services/feature-flag-service.ts, src/server/services/search-service.ts, src/server/services/attachment-service.ts, src/server/services/billing-service.ts, src/server/services/invitation-service.ts, src/server/services/comment-service.ts, src/server/services/webhook-service.ts, src/server/services/notification-service.ts, src/server/services/project-service.ts, src/server/services/organization-service.ts
